title: A Trip to the Mountains
text:
Last summer, Lucas went on a trip to the mountains with his brother. They took a small tent and a map. On the first day, they walked for six hours and saw a beautiful lake.

On the second day, the weather changed and it started to rain. The brothers stayed in their tent and played cards. In the evening the sun came out, and they saw a rainbow over the valley.

questions.text: What did the brothers do when it rained?
How did Lucas probably feel about the trip?
options: He was afraid of the lake.

questions.text: Why did the brothers play cards in the tent?
options: Because the rain stopped them from walking.
Because the tent was too big.

vocabulary.definition: a shelter made of cloth that you can carry and put up outdoors
a large area of water surrounded by land
a curve of many colours in the sky, seen when the sun shines through rain
a low area of land between hills or mountains

paragraph_translations: No verão passado, Lucas fez uma viagem às montanhas com o irmão. Eles levaram uma barraca pequena e um mapa. No primeiro dia, caminharam durante seis horas e viram um lago bonito.
No segundo dia, o tempo mudou e começou a chover. Os irmãos ficaram na barraca e jogaram cartas. À noite, o sol apareceu, e eles viram um arco-íris sobre o vale.
